61:            ``type`` attribute of an entity is contained in this list, it will be returned.
62:            Defaults to :attr:`telegram.MessageEntity.ALL_TYPES`.

149:    @staticmethod
150:    def adjust_message_entities_to_utf_16(text: str, entities: _SEM) -> _SEM:
151:        """Utility functionality for converting the offset and length of entities from
152:        Unicode (:obj:`str`) to UTF-16 (``utf-16-le`` encoded :obj:`bytes`).
153:
154:        Tip:
155:            Only the offsets and lengths calulated in UTF-16 is acceptable by the Telegram Bot API.
156:            If they are calculated using the Unicode string (:obj:`str` object), errors may occur
157:            when the text contains characters that are not in the Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP).
158:            For more information, see `Unicode <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unicode>`_ and
159:            `Plane (Unicode) <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plane_(Unicode)>`_.
160:
161:        .. versionadded:: 21.4
162:
163:        Examples:
164:            Below is a snippet of code that demonstrates how to use this function to convert
165:            entities from Unicode to UTF-16 space. The ``unicode_entities`` are calculated in
166:            Unicode and the `utf_16_entities` are calculated in UTF-16.
167:
168:            .. code-block:: python
169:
170:                text = "𠌕 bold 𝄢 italic underlined: 𝛙𝌢𑁍"
171:                unicode_entities = [
172:                    MessageEntity(offset=2, length=4, type=MessageEntity.BOLD),
173:                    MessageEntity(offset=9, length=6, type=MessageEntity.ITALIC),
174:                    MessageEntity(offset=28, length=3, type=MessageEntity.UNDERLINE),
175:                ]
176:                utf_16_entities = MessageEntity.adjust_message_entities_to_utf_16(
177:                    text, unicode_entities
178:                )
179:                await bot.send_message(
180:                    chat_id=123,
181:                    text=text,
182:                    entities=utf_16_entities,
183:                )
184:                # utf_16_entities[0]: offset=3, length=4
185:                # utf_16_entities[1]: offset=11, length=6
186:                # utf_16_entities[2]: offset=30, length=6
187:
188:        Args:
189:            text (:obj:`str`): The text that the entities belong to
190:            entities (Sequence[:class:`telegram.MessageEntity`]): Sequence of entities
191:                with offset and length calculated in Unicode
192:
193:        Returns:
194:            Sequence[:class:`telegram.MessageEntity`]: Sequence of entities
195:            with offset and length calculated in UTF-16 encoding
196:        """
197:        # get sorted positions
198:        positions = sorted(itertools.chain(*((x.offset, x.offset + x.length) for x in entities)))
199:        accumulated_length = 0
200:        # calculate the length of each slice text[:position] in utf-16 accordingly,
201:        # store the position translations
202:        position_translation: dict[int, int] = {}
203:        for i, position in enumerate(positions):
204:            last_position = positions[i - 1] if i > 0 else 0
205:            text_slice = text[last_position:position]
206:            accumulated_length += len(text_slice.encode(TextEncoding.UTF_16_LE)) // 2
207:            position_translation[position] = accumulated_length
208:        # get the final output entities
209:        out = []
210:        for entity in entities:
211:            translated_positions = position_translation[entity.offset]
212:            translated_length = (
213:                position_translation[entity.offset + entity.length] - translated_positions
214:            )
215:            new_entity = copy.copy(entity)
216:            with new_entity._unfrozen():
217:                new_entity.offset = translated_positions
218:                new_entity.length = translated_length
219:            out.append(new_entity)
220:        return out

223:    def shift_entities(by: Union[str, int], entities: _SEM) -> _SEM:
224:        """Utility functionality for shifting the offset of entities by a given amount.
225:
226:        Examples:
227:            Shifting by an integer amount:
228:
229:            .. code-block:: python
230:
231:                text = "Hello, world!"
232:                entities = [
233:                    MessageEntity(offset=0, length=5, type=MessageEntity.BOLD),
234:                    MessageEntity(offset=7, length=5, type=MessageEntity.ITALIC),
235:                ]
236:                shifted_entities = MessageEntity.shift_entities(1, entities)
237:                await bot.send_message(
238:                    chat_id=123,
239:                    text="!" + text,
240:                    entities=shifted_entities,
241:                )
242:
243:            Shifting using a string:
244:
245:            .. code-block:: python
246:
247:                text = "Hello, world!"
248:                prefix = "𝄢"
249:                entities = [
250:                    MessageEntity(offset=0, length=5, type=MessageEntity.BOLD),
251:                    MessageEntity(offset=7, length=5, type=MessageEntity.ITALIC),
252:                ]
253:                shifted_entities = MessageEntity.shift_entities(prefix, entities)
254:                await bot.send_message(
255:                    chat_id=123,
256:                    text=prefix + text,
257:                    entities=shifted_entities,
258:                )

261:            The :paramref:`entities` are *not* modified in place. The function returns a sequence

266:        Args:
267:            by (:obj:`str` | :obj:`int`): Either the amount to shift the offset by or
268:                a string whose length will be used as the amount to shift the offset by. In this
269:                case, UTF-16 encoding will be used to calculate the length.
270:            entities (Sequence[:class:`telegram.MessageEntity`]): Sequence of entities
271:
272:        Returns:
273:            Sequence[:class:`telegram.MessageEntity`]: Sequence of entities with the offset shifted
274:        """
275:        effective_shift = by if isinstance(by, int) else len(by.encode("utf-16-le")) // 2
276:
277:        out = []
278:        for entity in entities:
279:            new_entity = copy.copy(entity)

285:    @classmethod
286:    def concatenate(
287:        cls,
288:        *args: Union[tuple[str, _SEM], tuple[str, _SEM, bool]],
289:    ) -> tuple[str, _SEM]:
290:        """Utility functionality for concatenating two text along with their formatting entities.
291:
292:        Tip:
293:            This function is useful for prefixing an already formatted text with a new text and its
294:            formatting entities. In particular, it automatically correctly handles UTF-16 encoding.
295:
296:        Examples:
297:            This example shows a callback function that can be used to add a prefix and suffix to
298:            the message in a :class:`~telegram.ext.CallbackQueryHandler`:
299:
300:            .. code-block:: python
301:
302:                async def prefix_message(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
303:                    prefix = "𠌕 bold 𝄢 italic underlined: 𝛙𝌢𑁍 | "
304:                    prefix_entities = [
305:                        MessageEntity(offset=2, length=4, type=MessageEntity.BOLD),
306:                        MessageEntity(offset=9, length=6, type=MessageEntity.ITALIC),
307:                        MessageEntity(offset=28, length=3, type=MessageEntity.UNDERLINE),
308:                    ]
309:                    suffix = " | 𠌕 bold 𝄢 italic underlined: 𝛙𝌢𑁍"
310:                    suffix_entities = [
311:                        MessageEntity(offset=5, length=4, type=MessageEntity.BOLD),
312:                        MessageEntity(offset=12, length=6, type=MessageEntity.ITALIC),
313:                        MessageEntity(offset=31, length=3, type=MessageEntity.UNDERLINE),
314:                    ]
315:
316:                    message = update.effective_message
317:                    first = (prefix, prefix_entities, True)
318:                    second = (message.text, message.entities)
319:                    third = (suffix, suffix_entities, True)
320:
321:                    new_text, new_entities = MessageEntity.concatenate(first, second, third)
322:                    await update.callback_query.edit_message_text(
323:                        text=new_text,
324:                        entities=new_entities,
325:                    )
326:
327:        Hint:
328:            The entities are *not* modified in place. The function returns a
329:            new sequence of objects.
330:
331:        .. versionadded:: 21.5
332:
333:        Args:
334:            *args (tuple[:obj:`str`, Sequence[:class:`telegram.MessageEntity`]] | \
335:                tuple[:obj:`str`, Sequence[:class:`telegram.MessageEntity`], :obj:`bool`]):
336:                Arbitrary number of tuples containing the text and its entities to concatenate.
337:                If the last element of the tuple is a :obj:`bool`, it is used to determine whether
338:                to adjust the entities to UTF-16 via
339:                :meth:`adjust_message_entities_to_utf_16`. UTF-16 adjustment is disabled by
340:                default.
341:
342:        Returns:
343:            tuple[:obj:`str`, Sequence[:class:`telegram.MessageEntity`]]: The concatenated text
344:            and its entities
345:        """
346:        output_text = ""
347:        output_entities: list[MessageEntity] = []
348:        for arg in args:
349:            text, entities = arg[0], arg[1]
350:
351:            if len(arg) > 2 and arg[2] is True:
352:                entities = cls.adjust_message_entities_to_utf_16(text, entities)
353:
354:            output_entities.extend(cls.shift_entities(output_text, entities))
355:            output_text += text
356:
357:        return output_text, output_entities
358:
